reviews.t: These are great. It does require some prep work though
reviews.x: These are great. It does require some prep work though. You need to measure and cut the elastic and trim some of the flowers so don't wait until the last minute. I set up the headbands so the guests only need to add the flowers and embellishments. Additional items needed are a glue gun, plenty of glue sticks, scissors and a ruler (to measure and cut the elastic) and a sign with instructions for the day of the shower.

reviews.t: Nice quality product for the price.
reviews.x: Nice quality flowers, good variety. Good price if you consider cost per headband. Purchased for my daughter for her baby shower as a craft for guests. Requires a glue gun. I think it's a good package, but an improvement would be to add some sticky-backed Velcro dots and/ or a small bottle of craft glue. It would be nice if a webpage was provided where you could print out directions for guests and tags. This requires little cost on the sellers part as the customer would be using their own paper,

reviews.t: Gorgeous Kit
reviews.x: This was definitely a hit at the baby shower! The ladies loved it, especially mom-to-be! I loved the idea that we could all make something for the baby instead of just playing games! We could have turned It into a game by voting on the best, but we chose not to. It was definitely a fantastic buy! The colors, gems, elastic and all the components of this kit are great quality and simply beautiful!

reviews.t: I know I ready reviews and should have chosen better. This is a super cute idea but definitely ...
reviews.x: I know I ready reviews and should have chosen better. This is a super cute idea but definitely time consuming to cut everything out. Also most of the flowers were all the same just a different color. For price it was ok but not what I expected. Some of the flowers were not even usable and coming unraveled.

reviews.t: Great baby shower activity
reviews.x: This was a huge hit at the baby shower I threw! It was fun and different. All the ladies had fun. We used my 2 month olds head as a pattern. It would have been nice to have some sort of measuring tape in case there was not a baby there. It was a blast though. Everything was will made and easy to use.

reviews.t: Fun station at baby shower.
reviews.x: This was a hit at a baby shower I was putting on. Everyone really enjoyed being able to create the headbands for the baby. It really did come as I expected, however, some of the items are a bit tedious. You will need to cut the bands yourself to the size you want. I pre-cut everything before the shower so I didn't need to keep rulers out or anything. That took sometime. However, the embellishments that comes with the kit are beautiful and there are many different colors and options. Plenty of op

reviews.t: they were such a fun treat for the mommy to be
reviews.x: I bought these for my friend's baby shower. They are so cute, but they did require me to do a little work before hand. I cut them to the size needed, and then used a hot glue gun to get the bands to stick together. You could also sew them together. I then had to cut out the flowers. At the shower, they were such a fun treat for the mommy to be. We used a hot glue gun to attach the flowers. They all came out so cute, and I can't wait to see them on the little one.

reviews.t: BIG HIT!
reviews.x: As other reviewers have stated, it's best to do the work to get this station ready for guests:  cut netting from flowers and cut ribbon to lengths.  That being said, the guests at my shower LOVED this station.  It was so simple that the younger girls (8-12) did it too.  I did forget which ribbon was cut to which length, but I guess mom will figure it out when the baby gets here lol.

reviews.t: It came with instructions and was easy to put together before the shower
reviews.x: The headband kit was the exact same as the picture! It came with instructions and was easy to put together before the shower. It was a little time consuming as others mentioned with cutting the headbands to size, but it was no big deal and comes with the territory of shower projects. I'm sure the guests will love making their headbands for the mom to be!

reviews.t: Huge hit!
reviews.x: Huge hit for baby girl baby showers! Please note you'll need a little extra time to cut out some of the shabby flowers ahead of time. Some netted material will remain on the back of these flowers but is easily covered with the felt circles. Good selection of colors and small jewels.

reviews.t: But the quality was good. I'd would recommend this set for sure
reviews.x: I only took a star off because cutting the flowers off was trickier than just cutting around. But the quality was good. I'd would recommend this set for sure, just know you will have to put in a little work to get it ready for the shower.

reviews.t: The variety of the colors and print were adorable, but I'm pretty disappointed that there aren't enough ...
reviews.x: The variety of the colors and print were adorable, but I'm pretty disappointed that there aren't enough circular bases for the bands. There are only enough for 10 bands. I was hoping to not have to buy supplies by buying a kit.

reviews.t: Perfect for a Baby Shower
reviews.x: I bought this to use at my daughter's baby shower. It looks great. Everything is there we will need at the craft station and the quality is great. I'm looking forward to seeing what creations the guests come up with.

reviews.t: I thought it would come in a box or nice set up
reviews.x: I thought it would come in a box or nice set up. The packaging was surprising on how it came. Overall, we got several headbands made at the shower, but the price was over in my opinion for what came.

reviews.t: Nice kit but requires prep time
reviews.x: Colors are beautiful and true to the web image. Easy instructions. The mesh needs to be cut for each individual flower, so plan an extra two hours to prep the flowers prior to the event.

reviews.t: The kit was perfect and so easy to work with
reviews.x: The headband station at our baby shower was a big hit!  The kit was perfect and so easy to work with.  It was a nice way for people to interact as we were waiting for guests to arrive.

reviews.t: Súper recomendado
reviews.x: Una manera fácil y económica para hacer diferentes diseños de cintas de pelo para niñas. Me encanto, porque trae variedad de colores y de formas. Súper recomendado.

reviews.x: It was what I needed for the baby shower but it was annoying to cut out the "mesh" the flowers came on. In the end, everyone loved it.

reviews.t: Fun and useful baby shower craft.
reviews.x: Ordered these for a baby shower. Everyone had fun creating the cute headbands. Mommy will remember all the guests each time she dresses baby.

reviews.t: Just ok
reviews.x: Not what I expected, but worked out. Plan to add your own instructions if you are using it for a party. Also add addition clips.

reviews.t: High quality and better than I even expected
reviews.x: Bought for a baby shower, and these were a total hit! High quality and better than I even expected. Great value for the price!

reviews.x: Ordered this kit for a baby shower and it was such a hit! Comes with everything you need to make adorable headbands!

claims.text: Guests and hosts frequently describe it as a big hit and fun activity at baby showers.
Many reviewers note it requires prep work beforehand, especially cutting the headbands and flowers to size.
Reviewers praise the quality and variety of the flowers and colors.
Some reviewers feel the price is high or the kit lacks enough supplies, such as circular bases.
A few reviewers mention needing extra supplies like a glue gun or measuring tape.
